Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy of Intrigue

Although The Joruba Consortium is relatively unknown to the general populace, it is well respected in The Mid Rim business community as a capable wholesale distributor for a bewildering array of goods- Airspeeders, foodstuffs, holovid projectors, and much more. The Consortium does not produce these goods, but buys them in enormous quantities and ships them throughout the galaxy using its diverse fleet of Starships.

Beneath this veneer of respectability, however, lies a dark truth. The Joruba Consortium uses its shipping fleet, wealth, and bureaucratic favors to smuggle almost every type of illegal item known, including slaves, to the lawless planets of The Outer Rim.
